resolution_rule: For Phase-1 long_horizon own-state continuation, fetch the exact canonical_role_branch name first. Other similarly named role branches are archival/contender state and do not gain authority by recency or matching semantic payload. Within the canonical branch, require current-blob CAS plus monotonic checkpoint sequence/generation.
failure_rule: If the canonical branch or this authority file is missing or internally inconsistent, checkpoint a diagnostic and do not infer authority from another branch.
scope: Authority rule for this CLEAN role's repository transport only; does not defend against out-of-band force-push/deletion by an external principal.
zero_quota_assessment: Lightweight repository branch/file transport only; no protected-main merge, hosted runner, Codespaces, artifacts/LFS/packages, cloud/model credit, or manual execution step.
